comment: Solver command templates. {input}/{output}/{faces} are substituted per run. {exe} resolves from the env var named by exe_env, falling back to the 'exe' path if it exists on disk; solvers whose binary is absent are skipped. External GPL tools (quadwild) run as user-provided binaries only — never vendored. 'cyber' resolves its binary from --cyber-binary or the cpu-headless build tree.

quadwild.comment: quadwild-bimdf release binary (GPL-3, external only). No face-count flag: density comes from scaleFact in the prep config, so its counts are NOT comparable to a -f run — read its quality metrics per-density. Writes outputs next to the input; the harness relocates via output_from_input_suffix.
